# Resources: Graphic design

Posters, archives, decks, covers, packaging and the publications that track contemporary graphic design. The strongest moves available to a code-based designer are typographic, so typographic posters and historical archives are the richest sources.

Access reads `cost · agent access · licence`. Agent access: `static` = a plain web fetch can read it; `js` = needs a real browser; `blocked` = bot protection or a login wall, send the user the link instead; `unknown` = could not be reached from the maintainer's network when last checked (not proof that it is down). `login` = content is gated. Tier: `S` first place to look, `A` strong, `B` niche or with a clear weakness.

## Posters and typographic work

Study grid, scale contrast and how little is on the page.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Access | Tier |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Typographic Posters](https://www.typographicposters.com) | Thousands of contemporary typographic posters by designer, studio and country | Browse by designer for a coherent body of work; note grid and scale contrast | free · js | S |
| [Trend List](https://www.trendlist.org) | Graphic-design trends named and tagged across posters and print | Look up a trend to know how dated it is before using it | free · static · slow | A |
| [Museum fuer Gestaltung eMuseum](https://www.emuseum.ch) | Online collection of the Zurich design museum, including the Swiss poster tradition | Search by designer (Mueller-Brockmann, Hofmann) for canonical grid work | free · static | A |
| [Poster House](https://posterhouse.org) | Museum dedicated to posters, with exhibition archives | Context on poster history and genres | free · js | B |

## Design history archives

Authentic period references instead of pastiche.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Access | Tier |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Letterform Archive Online](https://oa.letterformarchive.org) | High-resolution archive of lettering, type specimens and graphic design; free registration | Search by decade, technique or country for authentic period references | free · static · login | S |
| [People's Graphic Design Archive](https://peoplesgdarchive.org) | Crowd-sourced archive including everyday and under-documented graphic design | Find vernacular references outside the canon | free · static | A |
| [AIGA Design Archives](https://designarchives.aiga.org) | Decades of juried American graphic design | Search by format (book, poster, identity) | free · blocked · archived | A |
| [Cooper Hewitt collection](https://www.si.edu/collections/cooper-hewitt) | Smithsonian design museum collection, now browsed through the Smithsonian collections site | Search by period, designer or object type | free · blocked · Many images are CC0; check each object | A |
| [Paul Rand](https://www.paulrand.design) | Comprehensive archive of Paul Rand's work and writing | Read the essays on logo presentation | free · unknown | A |

## Presentations and pitch decks

Narrative order first, slide system second.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Access | Tier |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Deck Gallery](https://deck.gallery) | Presentation and brand-book inspiration from well-known companies | Compare slide systems: title, statement, data, image layouts | free · static | A |
| [Best Pitch Decks](https://bestpitchdecks.com) | Real start-up pitch decks searchable by stage and sector | Study narrative order before styling anything | free · unknown | A |
| [Sequoia: Writing a Business Plan](https://www.sequoiacap.com/article/writing-a-business-plan/) | The canonical pitch narrative outline | Use as the default story spine for an investor deck | free · static · archived | A |
| [Pitch Deck Hunt](https://www.pitchdeckhunt.com) | Collection of notable pitch decks | Second source for deck structure | free · static | B |
| [Pitch templates](https://pitch.com/templates) | Professionally designed presentation templates | Reference for slide-layout systems | freemium · js · login | B |

## Covers and packaging

Single-idea composition under a fixed frame.

| Resource | Best for | How to use | Access | Tier |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Coverjunkie](https://coverjunkie.com) | Magazine covers chosen for their ideas | Reference for single-image, single-headline composition | free · js · slow | A |
| [Dieline](https://thedieline.com) | Leading packaging-design publication | Browse by category for shelf conventions | free · static | A |
| [Packaging of the World](https://packagingoftheworld.com) | Large packaging gallery by category and country | Scan a product category quickly | free · js | A |
| [Spine](https://spinemagazine.co) | Book-cover design process and interviews | See how cover concepts are developed and rejected | free · static | B |

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [It's Nice That](https://www.itsnicethat.com) | The most consistent editorial voice on contemporary graphic design and illustration | Follow for art-direction awareness beyond UI | free · static | S |
